note: Weights SparkSeek targets, pinned by revision. Capacity per Spark is from results/2026-10-26-weights (headers only; nothing served yet). Engram tables stay on each Spark's NVMe behind a row cache in every profile.

deepseek-fp8-mxfp4.role: Strict, TP4: DeepSeek's release as published (FP8 dense in 32x32 blocks, MXFP4 routed experts). 74.2 GiB per rank.

exl3-2.5bpw.role: Lossy, TP2: the only published pack that fits two Sparks with KV room (87.1 GiB per rank). Its Engram tables come from deepseek-fp8-mxfp4's engram_files.

considered.nvidia/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-NVFP4@c48dca0: Fits TP4 (78.2 GiB per rank), but it quantizes the September V4.1-Flash, not the 1017 update, and its MXFP4 Engram tables are lossy. Its routed-expert conversion is lossless, so the same cast can be applied to 1017's experts if Atlas's NVFP4 kernels beat MXFP4 ones.
considered.Mia-AiLab/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-EXL3-: 99.3 GiB per rank at TP2: no KV room at utilization 0.88; 4.1M positions at 0.90 and 8.4M at 0.93. A TP4 option.
considered.bertholomus/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-EXL: TP4 only (69.3 GiB per rank); closer to the release than 2.5 bpw (author's KL 0.033 vs 0.13).
considered.ISTA-DASLab/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-GSQ: IQ2_XXS / IQ2_XS backbones of 138 / 155 GB would fit TP2 with room, but Atlas has no IQ2 GPU kernels and no engine yet reads DeepSeek-V4.1 GGUF names except Strata.
